title: Lighting Reveal on a Held Rage Close-Up
summary: Shot 001 holds an extreme close-up almost still while warm light reveals and intensifies the expression. The production and Anime Intelligence readings come from the same analysis pass.
observed: The first sample is black; the face becomes readable by frame 8 and strongly illuminated by frame 16.
The facial drawing and framing remain nearly fixed while value and light change.
The shot lasts 22 frames and is an edge-to-edge extreme close-up.
principle: Increase perceived emotional force with minimal character motion.
